description: This file implements a configuration preprocessing system with environment variable management, function evaluation, variable expansion, and string processing utilities, primarily used in build configuration scripts.

methods.name: env_add
methods.description: Adds a new environment variable to the list.

methods.name: env_del
methods.description: Removes an environment variable from the list.

methods.name: env_expand
methods.description: Expands an environment variable by name, adding it to the list if found in the environment.

methods.name: env_write_dep
methods.description: Writes environment variable dependencies to a file.

methods.name: variable_lookup
methods.description: Looks up a variable by name in the variable list.

methods.name: variable_add
methods.description: Adds or updates a variable with specified flavor and value.

methods.name: variable_del
methods.description: Deletes a variable from the list.

methods.name: variable_all_del
methods.description: Deletes all variables from the list.

methods.name: eval_clause
methods.description: Evaluates a clause with arguments, returning a string result.

methods.name: expand_dollar_with_args
methods.description: Expands a string following a '$' with arguments.

methods.name: expand_string_with_args
methods.description: Expands variables and functions within a string with arguments.

methods.name: expand_string
methods.description: Expands variables and functions within a string.
